about_the_game:
Cthulhu stops the Drug Trade in New Heatsing is a turn-based RPG where you use cards to fight against your enemies! In this game, you'll play as Cthulhu—a Monster of seemingly unlimited powers—in her humanoid form. Travel through forests, sewers, power plants, snowy peaks, and even a floating island as you slowly dismantle an evil organisation!

-----Story-----

One day, Cthulhu found one of the members of the annoying cult that follows her everywhere doing something that they shouldn't. This mildly annoyed her, enough to start an epic quest.

-----Tone-----
This game is light-hearted, so don't expect much heavy stuff.

-----Meet Your Party-----

Cthulhu is not alone on this quest! Throughout the game, you will meet various people to support you, some might even join in your adventure!

Cthulhu will team up with.

  • Dr.David, a laid-back scientist

  • G2, a muscular cat chasing his next adrenaline rush

  • Chelsa, a goddess advocating for justice

  • Schnee, a sorceress of snow

-----Key Features-----

This game features many things, including;

  • Deck building: Customize your battle cards and create strategies based on your decks.

  • Procedural dungeons: Every dungeon is randomly generated, filled with random loot, various encounters, and dungeon exclusive cards, giving you a roguelite experience.

  • Narrative-based storytelling: With hidden lore about the world or characters, the occasional pointless interactions, and many twists and turns.

  • Exploration: Discover many locations, some mandatory and others optional.

  • Minigames: Play various minigames, whether for highscores, items, or literally no reasons.

  • Extra content: Multiple side quests, secrets, hidden encounters, special cards, achievements, and bonus dungeons.

  • And more!

So what are you waiting for? Join in on our adventure!
